description: Synthetic signed raw-key status controls for CRL Time choice. Whole-second UTC years 1950-2049 use UTCTime; later years and pre-1950 compatibility use GeneralizedTime. Legacy GeneralizedTime CRLs remain readable. invalidityDate and OCSP remain GeneralizedTime-only. Expected full decisions include operational and knowledge-time boundaries. Signature math does not admit an issuer/responder path or establish complete document trust. Pre-1950 compatibility is not an RFC issuer-profile conformance claim.
